family.description: ThrE is a family of bacterial and Archaeal proteins that catalyse the export of L-threonine from the cell [[cite:PUB00075540]]. UniProtKB:Q79VD1 has been characterised as being necessary for this export. The domain exhibits 10 putative TMs and catalyses the proton-motive-force-dependent efflux of threonine and serine [[cite:PUB00075541]].
family.name: Putative threonine/serine exporter
